speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis with probable underlying asthma or early COPD phenotype, given the recurrent infections, morning-predominant cough, purulent sputum, and spirometry showing reduced lung volumes with a preserved ratio. The chest X-ray findings of airway thickening and focal opacities may represent acute exacerbations superimposed on chronic airway inflammation; further evaluation of lung function post-bronchodilation and consideration of high-resolution CT may be warranted if symptoms persist or if there is concern for bronchiectasis.
